title: Daily seasonality in crude oil returns and volatilities
source_revision: Auer2014, EnergyEconomics43,82–88; primary publisher preview plus indexed abstract
findings: Source reports lower Monday returns/higher volatility; long-short improvement over passive is not statistically significant.
mechanism: Calendar effects hypothesized; no verified economic profit.
build_on: Publisher data preview specifies spot prices. No blind CL futures or intraday transfer.
code_feasibility: Descriptive dummy regression is possible with matching data; not an admitted futures rule.
summary: No strong new net futures hypothesis established in available metadata.
owned_input_map: CL futures minutes are not the source Datastream spot-price ledger.
reading_scope: Publisher abstract/highlights/method/data preview and RePEc abstract; full source not read.
